biggest_catch: There is no cash payout — Shopping Rewards convert only to digital gift cards, the redemption minimum is whatever Capital One shows at checkout (not a published number), and Capital One's own affiliate rules forbid calling it 'cash back'.
catches: Rewards are redeemable for digital gift cards only — not cash, not checks, not PayPal.
The minimum redemption amount is dynamic and shown only at redemption; it is not published as a fixed number.
Reward rates vary by merchant and offer; rewards are not guaranteed income.
Merchant and category exclusions apply; gift-card purchases are commonly excluded.
Purchases must be tracked through the extension; ad blockers or broken affiliate attribution can mean no rewards.
Capital One Shopping tracks your browsing and shopping activity — a real privacy trade-off.

steps: Install the Capital One Shopping browser extension and create a free account.
Shop online with the extension active so purchases are tracked and Shopping Rewards accrue.
Open your rewards balance when you are ready to redeem.
Choose a digital gift card; the amount and any disclaimers are shown at redemption.
Confirm the order and watch for the confirmation email within 24–72 business hours; the gift card is issued within up to three business days.
